name: Latvia
kernel_parts_used: Schedule (25,5/33 % in cents; progressive, mono, convex, Lipschitz, le_maxRate, splitting instantiated)
Family.taxAfterLowBand / lowBandReduction (deductions at the lowest rate; lowBand_le_zeroBand instantiated)
kernel_gaps: deductions credited at a fixed 25,5 % even when they offset 33 % income (IIN 15(15)): schedule minus rate x deductions beyond taxAfterLowBand
a contribution ceiling that binds only the employer: employee pays 10,5 % above 105 300 as solidarity tax, employer refunded (Solidaritates nodokla likums 6.2(3)); deductible part cut by IIN 10(1.10)
self-employed contribution base with a monthly all-or-nothing minimum (31,07 % on the minimum wage) and a 10 % top-up rate above it (VSAOI 14.1); monthly test
final-withholding alternative regimes for the same income (author royalties 25 % with an 80/20 VSAOI/IIN split; micro-enterprise tax 25 % of turnover)
allocation of indivisible per-child reliefs between parents (exe tries every split)
spouse relief conditioned on marriage, no employment and the children's ages
monthly withholding at one rate vs annual two-rate tax (perPeriod not needed: closed form withholding_gap)

validation.referee: OECD TW 2025 (Taxing Wages 2026, year 2025) country table
validation.notes: 8 household types x 7 lines (CGTC, CGITLETC, CGITFP, SLT, EECSSC, CTGG, THP); generic mapping; b38.py oecd LV

validation.referee: OECD TW 2025 tax-wedge decomposition (DSD_TAX_WAGES_DECOMP), 50-250 % AW x 4 household types
validation.notes: 804 households; IT_CG, EESSC, CB 2412/2412 exact; NWE 788/804 exact, all within 1.2 EUR (contract rounding of three outputs to whole euro); tools/oecd_decomp.py

validation.referee: VID 'Algas nodoklis' 2025 worked examples 1-8 and 'Attaisnotie izdevumi' examples 1/5 and 9
validation.notes: monthly wage tax incl. non-resident, foreign-insured (33 % above 8 775/month), working pensioner 9,25 % and izdienas 9,76 %; 600-euro cap worth 153; 10 % pension cap; kernel-checked by decide in LvTax/Tests.lean (13 values from the 8 payroll examples, 2 from the deduction examples)

validation.referee: Monthly withholding vs annual return (own, not a referee)
validation.notes: equal up to 105 300; above it the return adds 10,05 % of the excess (7,5 % proved: withholding_gap; 2,55 % from IIN 10(1.10)); runs/lv_scan.md section 5

headline: Latvia's 2025 IIN/VSAOI/benefit model in Lean matches the OECD to the euro (56/56 country lines; 3 200/3 216 decomposition lines exact, all within 1 %) and 8 VID payroll examples; new: a self-employed notch at the 740-euro minimum wage (1 393 euro lost for one euro, a 2 080-euro dead band) that monthly bunching avoids (1 277 a year), and a 765-euro spouse-relief notch and marriage bonus; VID's 2025 guide misstates the 33 % base and drops micro income from the 3 % rate without a statutory basis, and IIN 12(1) still prints 570 euro for 2025.
